topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's themes and outlines the learning objectives.

topics.label: Tumor virology and cellular transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the study of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays for cell transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, tumor suppressors, and cell cycle regulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the functional classification of cancer genes and examine the mechanistic effects of mutations in regulators like Rb and p53.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defects in specific DNA repair pathways, replication enzymes, and mitotic segregation cause sequence and chromosomal instability.

topics.label: Multi-step tumorigenesis and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the stepwise accumulation and inheritance of cancer-associated mutations drive tumor progression and malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session, suggests supplementary reading, and previews the next lecture.
